subject: The history of the sword: Philip V of Macedon and the Roman gladius in 200 BC (Livy), early humans and the Schoningen spears, the Arslantepe arsenical copper swords, bronze and iron, swords as rank (royal burials, knighthood), the Roman legion, the sword in Arab culture (Dhu al-Fiqar, Abu Tammam's Amorium ode), gunpowder, killing at a distance (Grossman, On Killing), autonomous weapons and the 2026 Geneva CCW process
title: L’histoire de l’épée
